prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint changes showed no clear effect across all 4 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption incentive, adoption layout, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, home redesign, home wait_info, sign_in copy, sign_in redesign, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for final welcome screen: Redesigns the home intro screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated pet greeting card and prominent completion action. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support reported confusion on pet behavior immediately following onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet preview style selection new screen in adoption: Inserts a new companion preview screen before certification where users can preview their chosen pet's default idle animation style. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9%) and support emails noted custom pet generation errors or unexpected appearances.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Card layout security redesign for sign-in screen: Redesigns the sign-in screen with a card layout that includes a cloud sync badge and account safety indicators. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) involved missing or reset pets after signing back in, showing account cloud save confusion.)
3: [adoption, layout] Carousel pet browsing layout for friend selection: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a carousel view with clear pet personality labels. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and high median time (89s).)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign-in cloud save account protection copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize account restoration and cloud pet retention. (why: Eight support tickets last week specifically mentioned pets missing or resetting upon re-authentication.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop readiness sound and alert notification: Adds ready notification sound and toggle components to the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Users spend long mean durations (2336s) waiting for background asset creation; audio alerts bring them back instantly.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen live estimated completion timer: Enables the show_time_estimate indicator and adds a countdown timer component to the waiting screen. (why: High waiting screen mean time (2336s) causes drop-offs without clear time expectation.)
